content.title: Plans that grow with every model you ship
content.body: Every plan includes builder seats and a monthly build allowance. As your project adds models and metric traffic, the plan grows with the value it delivers to you.

content.title: Add-ons that scale with your usage
content.body: Nothing to commit up front. Turn an add-on on for a self-hosted project or a hosted plan, and pay only for what runs. [Read how metering is calculated](#).

cards.title: Warm Cache
cards.p1: Warm Cache remembers what each model produced last time and skips work when nothing upstream moved. Fewer rebuilds mean shorter runs and lower warehouse bills for the whole team.
cards.p2: Billing counts each distinct model, check or snapshot that Warm Cache reuses on a given day, once.

content.title: Plan FAQs
content.body: Answers to the questions teams ask most while choosing a plan for the first time.

items.q: Can I switch plans later on?
items.a: Yes. Upgrades apply right away and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing period, and nothing in your project is deleted.

items.q: What counts as a builder seat?
items.a: Anyone who can edit models, run jobs or open pull requests. People who only browse docs, lineage and the catalog are free and unlimited on every plan.

items.q: What happens when we pass our monthly build allowance?
items.a: Runs keep going. Extra builds are billed at the rate on your order form, and admins get an email when usage reaches 80% of the allowance.

items.q: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits?
items.a: Registered nonprofits and teaching programs get Workshop at a reduced rate. Write to our team with proof of status and we will set it up.

items.q: Is a credit card required to start the Sketchpad or Workshop trial?
items.a: No. Both start without payment details. You add a card only when you decide to keep Workshop after the trial ends.

content.title: Billing and usage questions
content.body: How invoices, meters and add-ons work once your team is up and running.

items.a: Monthly plans are invoiced on the day you subscribed. Annual Atelier contracts are invoiced up front, with usage overages billed each quarter.
Cards on monthly plans; cards, bank transfer or purchase orders on annual contracts.

items.q: How is Warm Cache usage metered?
items.a: Each model, check or snapshot that Warm Cache reuses on a given day counts once, no matter how many runs reused it that day.

items.q: Can I cap spend on Model Muse tokens?
items.a: It can. An owner sets a spending limit in settings; once Muse hits that limit it stops drafting until the following month begins.

items.q: Where can I see current usage?
items.a: The Usage page in account settings shows builds, metric queries and add-on meters, updated hourly.

items.q: Do unused allowances carry over to the next month?
items.a: No. Allowances reset on the first day of each billing month.

items.q: We run Lattice on our own servers. Can we keep that and pay only for add-ons?
items.a: Yes. Both add-ons work with self-hosted projects. Connect the project to a free account and only metered usage is billed.
